concepts.name: JawPort
concepts.prompt: EXACTLY SQUARE 1:1 logo image, equal width and height. Design ONE original professional logo symbol for NetCroc, a quiet desktop network utility. This is a completely new creative direction. NO CLOUDS. NO UPLOAD OR DOWNLOAD ARROWS. NO full-body crocodile holding any object. No cartoon mascot, no big cute eyes, no illustrative scene. Crisp flat vector-like design, bold simple shapes, strong negative space, excellent small app-icon readability. Keep composition compact and centered with generous transparent padding. Use a consistent very dark forest green and restrained emerald palette; creativity must come from structural design, not color changes. No text, no wordmark, no watermarks, no mockups, no glow, no gradients, no shadow. Transparent background. Core concept: crocodile jaws become an Ethernet port. Build a compact icon with the silhouette of realistic long crocodile upper and lower jaws surrounding a central negative-space RJ45 Ethernet socket; exactly four or six clean connector contacts serve as subtle teeth. The fusion of crocodile mouth and network connector should be clever and instantly legible, highly simplified, NOT a drawing of a crocodile next to a plug. Square balanced symbol, not a wide animal.

concepts.name: Signal Eye
concepts.prompt: OUTPUT EXACTLY 1024 BY 1024 PIXELS, SQUARE 1:1 CANVAS. Design a square app icon for NetCroc. Original idea: SIGNAL EYE. One real crocodile eye represented by a bold geometric eye cutout set within a tall diamond-shaped armored plate, compact and as tall as it is wide. The iris is constructed from two thick concentric broken signal arcs around a vertical reptile slit pupil, suggesting monitoring and networking. Use strong flat dark forest green and emerald shapes on a transparent background. The diamond/armored shape must be tall and compact, NOT an elongated horizontal eye illustration. Only a few sharply drawn shapes, no detailed scales, no cute character, no entire animal, no clouds, no arrows, no text, no watermark, no realistic rendering, no glow, no gradient, no shadow. A crisp, clever contemporary software brand mark intended to be readable at 32 pixels. All artwork inside a SQUARE 1:1 canvas with clear padding. Do not generate a landscape image.
